info.title: v2.product.get_item_content_diagnosis_result
info.description: Get the content quality details (including content quality level, content issues, and system suggestions) for specific product list.

post.description: Get the content quality details (including content quality level, content issues, and system suggestions) for specific product list.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: quality_level
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Item's latest content quality level. Applicable values: 0: NONE (No quality level for item in SELLER_DELETE / SHOPEE_DELETE / BANNED status) 1: TO_BE_IMPROVED 2: QUALIFIED 3: EXCELLENT

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: issue_type
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Item's content issue. Applicable values: 1: TOO_FEW_IMAGES 2: WRONG_CATEGORY 3: TOO_FEW_ATTRIBUTES_FOR_QUALIFIED 4: LACK_OF_SIZE_CHART 5: LACK_OF_STANDARD_VARIATION 6: LACK_BRAND 7: TOO_SHORT_DESCRIPTION 8: TOO_SHORT_OR_TOO_LONG_NAME 9: WRONG_WEIGHT 10: LACK_OF_VIDEO 11: TOO_FEW_ATTRIBUTES_FOR_EXCELLENT

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: suggestion
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: System suggestion for item's content issue. Applicable values: Add at least 3 images Adopt suggested category Add at least 1 attributes Add size chart Adopt the color or size variation Add brand info Add at least 100 characters or 1 image for desc Add characters for name to 25~100 Adopt suggested weight Add video Add at least 3 attributes

x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Shopee's unique identifier for an item.
